'''Peter Henri Bortoft''' (1938 – 29 December 2012)<ref name="SchumacherTribute">{{cite web
 | last1 = Harding
 | first1 = Stephan
 | last2 = Franses
 | first2 = Philip
 | last3 = Shaw
 | first3 = Patricia
 | title = A Tribute to Henri Bortoft
 | publisher = [[Schumacher College]]
 | date = January 2013
 | url = https://www.schumachercollege.org.uk/news/henri-bortoft-tribute
 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20210618060642/https://www.schumachercollege.org.uk/news/henri-bortoft-tribute
 | archive-date = 18 June 2021
 | url-status = dead
 | access-date = 2013-01-08}}</ref> was a British independent researcher and teacher, lecturer and writer on physics and the [[philosophy of science]]. He is best known for his work ''The Wholeness of Nature'', considered a relevant and original recent interpretation of [[Goethean science]].<ref name="waldorf 1">{{cite web
  | last = Seamon
  | first = David
  | title = Henri Bortoft. The Wholeness of Nature: Goethe's Way Toward a Science of Conscious Participation in Nature 
  | work = The Online Waldorf Library
  | publisher = 
  | date = 1997
  | url = http://www.arch.ksu.edu/seamon/Bortoft_review.htm
  | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20120415015804/http://www.arch.ksu.edu/seamon/Bortoft_review.htm
  | archive-date = 15 April 2012
  | url-status = dead
  | access-date = 27 April 2023
}} Originally appeared in ''Parabola'', 22, 3 (Fall 1997): 90-91.</ref><ref name="waldorf 2">{{cite web
  | last = Barnes
  | first = John
  | title = January 1997, Volume 02 #1: Book Review: The Wholeness of Nature 
  | work = The Online Waldorf Library
  | publisher = 
  | date = January 1997
  | url = https://www.waldorflibrary.org/journals/22-research-bulletin/465-january-1997-volume-02-1-book-review-the-wholeness-of-nature
  | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20230427150555/https://www.waldorflibrary.org/journals/22-research-bulletin/465-january-1997-volume-02-1-book-review-the-wholeness-of-nature
  | archive-date = 27 April 2023
  | url-status = live
  | access-date = 27 April 2023
}}</ref> His book ''Taking Appearance Seriously: The Dynamic Way of Seeing in Goethe and European Thought'' was published in 2012.

== Education ==
Bortoft completed his studies at the [[University of Hull]],<ref name="sirius online">{{cite web
  | last = Staff
  | title = Henri Bortoft 
  | language = de
  | publisher = www2.siriusonline.de
  | date = 30 April 2008
  | url = http://www2.siriusonline.de/verlag/autoren.nsf/Autoren/9A1B65B9412C0A16C1256E4E005F4186?OpenDocument
  | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20120425143345/http://www2.siriusonline.de/verlag/autoren.nsf/Autoren/9A1B65B9412C0A16C1256E4E005F4186?OpenDocument
  | archive-date = 25 April 2012
  | url-status = dead
  | access-date = 27 April 2023 
}}</ref> and then performed postgraduate research on the foundations of [[quantum physics]] at [[Birkbeck College]], where theoretical physicist [[David Bohm]] introduced him to the problem of [[Holism in science|wholeness]] in quantum theory. Subsequently, Bortoft worked with [[John G. Bennett]] on Bennett's [[Systematics – study of multi-term systems|''Systematics'']] (also known as Multi-Term Systems), which was Bennett's methodology for assisting the systematic and progressive understanding of systems, complexity, and wholeness, and on efforts with Bennett and with Kenneth W. Pledge to develop a formal language that was rigorously descriptive of scientific activity. Those efforts were published in ''Systematics: The Journal of the Institute for the Comparative Study of History, Philosophy and the Sciences'', listed below.

== Career ==
{{unreferencedsect|date=October 2026}}
Bortoft taught physics and philosophy of science at [[Schumacher College]] in the framework of the program in ''Holistic Science''. He held numerous lectures and seminars in Great Britain and the United States on the scientific work of [[Johann Wolfgang von Goethe]] and on the [[Modern science|development of modern science]].

==Death==
Bortoft died on 29 December 2012 at his home in [[Matlaske]], [[Norfolk]], aged 74.<ref>{{cite web |author=Staff |url=https://www.edp24.co.uk/memorials/death-notices/death/30142551.peter-henri-bortoft/ |title=PETER HENRI BORTOFT : Death - FamilyNotices24 - Eastern Daily Press |publisher=FamilyNotices24 |date=19 July 2022 |access-date=27 April 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230427143326/https://www.edp24.co.uk/memorials/death-notices/death/30142551.peter-henri-bortoft/ |archive-date=27 April 2023 |url-status=live }}</ref>
